intent: An author on the Add Fields step (click the tab whose data-testid is envelope-editor-step-addFields if it is not already showing) places three fields on the PDF canvas AT THREE CLEARLY SEPARATED POSITIONS (e.g. top-left, center, bottom-right of the canvas — close/overlapping placements land the next click on the already-placed field's own shape instead of empty canvas), selects the first with a plain click, adds the second to the selection with a Shift+click, then MUST ACTUALLY CLICK the floating toolbar's Remove button (the button whose title attribute is 'Remove' — find it, then click it, not just find it) to remove the selected pair; exactly one field row remains persisted for the envelope afterward.

claims.scope: envelope's persisted field rows after placing 3 fields and removing a shift-selected pair
